newsitem.title: USA: Moog Inc to acquire Moog Controls Inc.
newsitem.headline: Moog Inc to acquire Moog Controls Inc.

text.p: Moog Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire the principal assets of Moog Controls Inc from International Motion Control Inc for about $48.6 million.
Moog Controls was formed in 1988 when Moog Inc exchanged the company's U.S. Industrial Hydraulics Division for stock held by Bill Moog, the company's founder.

Moog Inc Chairman and Chief Executive R. T. Brady said in a statement that the acquisition would complement the company's overseas industrial capabilities and its aerospace business in the United States.
Brady also said he expected it would "be an earnings contributor from Day One."
Moog Inc manufactures controls used in commercial, industrial, aerospace and defense applications.
